allocated.description: The amount of allowances allocated for the calendar year.

bankedHeld.description: The amount of allowances of vintage years up to but not including the current compliance year held in a compliance account. (This is for NBP, OTC)

currentHeld.description: The amount of current vintage year allowances held in a compliance account at compliance. (This is for NBP, OTC)

totalAllowancesHeld.description: The total amount of allowances held in the account at compliance.

complianceYearEmissions.description: The total amount of pollutant in short tons emitted by the source in a control period.

otherDeductions.description: The sum of other deductions that may have occurred for the account, including Underutilization, Phase I Extension, Projected Emissions Deduction (for Phase I reports), State Cap Deductions, Deduction of Loaned Allowances, July Confirmation Deduction, and Substitution Control by Contract Deduction.

totalRequiredDeductions.description: Sum of Compliance year emissions + Other deductions.

currentDeductions.description: The amount of allowances with the current vintage year deducted at compliance. (This is for NBP, OTC)

deductOneToOne.description: Banked allowances with a 1 to 1 ratio. (This is for OTC, NBP)

deductTwoToOne.description: Banked allowances with a 2 to 1 ratio. (This is for OTC, NBP)

totalAllowancesDeducted.description: The total amount of allowances deducted at compliance.

carriedOver.description: The amount of allowances remaining in the account following compliance.

excessEmissions.description: The amount of pollutant in short tons emitted in excess of the number of allowances held.

inCompliance.description: A facility is in compliance if, at the end of the compliance period, the facility owns enough allowances to cover the amount of pollutant emitted (or for ARP NOx, the actual emissions rate of the pollutant was below the emissions limit).
